title: Sources: Microsoft is restricting employees from using Claude Fable 5 because of Anthropic's new 30-day data retention requirements (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Sources: Microsoft is restricting employees from using Claude Fable 5 because of Anthropic's new 30-day data retention requirements — Microsoft's legal teams are evaluating Anthropic's new data retention changes. … Anthropic released Claude Fable, its first Mythos-class AI model …
